content.title: Le Grand Apartment
content.body:
## An Absolute Gem
One of my **favorite** places ever. I am glad that I decided to visit this place.

> "A true home away from home."

Here is why I loved it:
* Great ambiance
* <u>Superb</u> cleanliness
* Friendly staff

content.title: My review
content.body:
### Highly Recommended!
**Absolutely Grand!** That is *all* I have to say for this wonderful place.

1. Check-in was a breeze
2. Amenities were ~~okay~~ fantastic!
3. The view is <u>unbeatable</u>

content.title: Fantastic For Us
content.body:
## Student Paradise
I have stayed at this apartment for a while, and let me say, it is **as the name says**.

It's a *really cool* apartment and it has a lot of the amenities that a student would want:
* Fast Wi-Fi
* Study desks
* <u>Quiet environment</u>

> Perfect for cramming before finals!
content.reply: Glad to hear that you were satisfied with our space! ^_^
